content:
alex: hey @maya @chris — I pushed a followup to the routing PR with the changes you requested: split out the fallback logic into its own helper, added the changelog entry, and tightened the unit that was flaking. PTAL when you have a sec.
maya: thanks — will take a look in ~30m. quick q: did you keep the original commits or squash? trying to figure out backfill for bisects.
alex: left history intact (split commits) but I can squash if you prefer. the main reason I kept them was to preserve the test-repro case in the middle commit.
chris: skimmed diff — looks good from a runtime perspective. can you run the specific flaky test locally and paste the command you used? i want to confirm the assertion change is enough.
alex: sure — ran:
```
pytest tests/unit/test_routing.py::test_region_fallback -k flaky_repro -q
```
CI is green now (all checks passed) — see the last run: https://ci.internal/1738/builds/984
maya: rechecked the helper naming + docstring nit, left one tiny comment inline. otherwise :thumbsup: for me. prefer not to squash, keeps the history useful.
katie: heads up — we have a canary slot at 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z (3pm UTC). if this needs to go before tomorrow's deploy window, please merge into main before then and ping ops. otherwise we can roll it with the normal canary.
alex: plan: address maya's tiny comment now, push fixup, then PTAL again. if no objections by 14:50 UTC I'll merge and queue for the 15:00 canary. preference: keep commits unless chris insists on a squash.
chris: sounds fine to me. since CI is green and tests are updated, +1. if anything goes wrong during canary we can automatically roll back.
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved for commit 0f3a2b4 at 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z — will run smoke e2e and monitor for 30m.
alex: fixed the docstring and pushed a small tweak — pinging @maya @chris again PTAL (tiny change). thanks!
maya: LGTM, no more notes.
chris: LGTM. merge when ready.
alex: merging in ~5m unless someone yells. thanks all.
deploy-bot: Merge queued by alex. Merge completed; commit 0f3a2b4 landed on main at 2026-03-18T14:57:12Z.
